body: It appears I am not able to post a one-star review, suspicious. So I will make this 5 stars simply to ensure it gets seen. Each book is likely more than 500 4 page chapters, since authors get paid by volume, not quality. You could pay $60 and not get halfway through a book. Plus, you only get two chapters for free (you watch two ads each free chapter, but I’m fine with that as an alternative since paying over $150 isn’t feasible for like. Literally anyone on earth right now except the 1% rich, and they are not using these apps.) and after that you have to wait 2 days. I like the book I’m reading, but unfortunately the author has fallen into the “quantity over quality” trap and the chapters are as short as 4 pages, which seems common with every book available. If I am unable to watch ads to read for free, I will simply uninstall.

title: Marrying her was easy, Losing her was hell
body: Marrying Her Was Easy, Losing Her Is Hell had me hooked almost immediately. Even without being finished, I can already say this book is an emotional hurricane in the best way. The writing is sharp, the emotions hit hard, and the characters feel so real that it’s impossible not to get pulled into their world. Every chapter so far has been packed with tension, longing, and that deep, messy passion that makes a story unforgettable. I’ve already laughed, clenched my jaw, and had my heart squeezed more times than I can count — and I’m not even done yet. What stands out most is how effortlessly the author draws you in. The pacing is perfect, the intensity is addictive, and the connection between the characters is absolutely undeniable. I keep telling myself “one more chapter,” and then suddenly it’s been an hour. If the rest of the book keeps building like this, I already know it’s going to be one of those reads that sticks with me. Even midway through, it’s clear: this story is something special.

But until then it’s a cool reading app. And the chapters are a little longer that most apps too. Keep up the good work team! Great stories. I might have to publish one lol.

title: Relaxing
body: This app gives you a good way to unwind and pass the time. I will admit watching ads to get the next chapter is a little frustrating because you can only watch so many ads to get a handful of chapters more. If the app would just continue the option to watch more ads to get more chapters it would most likely bring more traffic to the app. But it’s alright for a short period, for now at least.
